colloquial_usage.why_it_took: Cultural compression: short, blunt, and speakable under stress. A name that survives being shouted.
colloquial_usage.what_the_name_asserts: Calling it a Spade preserves field reality — a working implement that protects first and punishes only when crossed.
colloquial_usage.significance: Doctrine encoded in vocabulary. The Marshal blade is named for a tool rather than a weapon, and the slang is how that framing is carried in everyday speech.

prose_ledger_triage.note: The "spade" match was initially suspected as a truncation of "spatha". It is not — it is recorded in-world slang and an existing alias, alongside "Marshal blade".
